title: How to Enable Dark Mode on Windows 11? - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Switching to dark mode on Windows 11 not only reduces eye strain but also gives your system a sleek and modern look. If you're wondering how to enable dark mode on Windows 11, this guide will walk you through the process step by step. By adjusting your Windows 11 dark theme settings, you can personalize your desktop and apps to match your preferences. Learn how to turn on dark mode quickly and easily in this straightforward tutorial.

  • How to Enable Dark Mode in Windows 11?
  • How to Enable Dark Contrast on Windows 11?
  • How to Turn On Night Light in Windows 11?
  • How to Enable Dark Mode on Windows 11 - FAQs

How to Enable Dark Mode in Windows 11?

Enabling dark mode in Windows 11 is a simple process that enhances the visual appeal of your system while reducing eye strain, especially during nighttime use. Follow these easy steps to enable Dark Mode on your Windows 11 device:

Step 1: Click on the 'Start' button in the taskbar.

Step 2: Select 'Settings' (gear-shaped icon) to open the Settings menu. or use shortcut Win + I to Open Settings

Step 3: Within the Settings, click on 'Personalization.'

Step 4: In the right sidebar, choose 'Colors.'

Step 5: On the 'Choose your mode' dropdown menu.

Step 6: Select 'Dark' to enable Dark Mode instantly.

After doing this, your Windows interface is going to be colored in a dark tone. Hence, file explorers, menus, and any other system elements are going to be changed.

Color choices!

Users can choose a color for the accent in Windows 11, making it possible to set the theme of their PC. The color in focus is widely used on windows objects that need to have obvious visibility, like a notification icon in the toolbar, the highlight button of an action bar, etc.

Microsoft has made it possible for Windows 11 users to match this accent color automatically by default. They do this based on the colors in their current desktop wallpapers to create uniformity.

Alternatively, if you want to go for a manual selection, select “manual” from the dropdown menu. In case we don’t have enough tiles on the main view one could select RGB colors from custom colors.

How to Enable Dark Contrast on Windows 11?

Enabling dark mode in Windows 11 is a straightforward process that enhances visibility and reduces eye strain, especially in low-light environments. Follow these simple steps to customize your system's contrast settings:

Step 1: Click on the 'Start' button in the taskbar.

Step 2: Select 'Settings' (gear-shaped icon) to open the Settings menu. or use shortcut Win + I to Open Settings

Step 3: Within the Settings, click on 'Personalization.'

Step 4: In the right sidebar, choose 'Colors.'

Step 5: Click on Contrast themes.

Step 6: On the Contrast themes dropdown you can choose Night Sky to apply Dark Theme

Step 7: Then, Click on Apply

How to Turn On Night Light in Windows 11?

The Night Light feature in Windows 11 helps reduce eye strain and improve sleep quality. Enable Dark Mode is simple:

Step 1: Click on the 'Start' button in the taskbar.

Step 2: Select 'Settings' (gear-shaped icon) to open the Settings menu. or use shortcut Win + I to Open Settings

Step 3: Navigate to 'System' and click on 'Display.'

Step 4: Then, Click on Night Light

Step 5: Click On Turn On Now

Step 6: Use the slider to increase the Strength

  • You can then modify these settings to suit your specific goals and needs, be it increasing or decreasing intensity and frequency. Your screen will display warm tones in the evening as Night Light is turned on making your screenview more pleasant.
  • The dark mode in Windows 11 features provides constant and enriching visuals and usability for various programs that guarantee uniformity in the dark theme experience.

Conclusion

Enabling dark mode on Windows 11 is a simple and effective way to enhance both the appearance and usability of your system. By following the steps outlined above, you can easily activate the dark theme on Windows 11 and make your desktop more visually comfortable. Don't forget to explore and customize dark mode in Windows 11 to further personalize your experience and make the most out of the dark mode settings.
